# Google Text To Speech for Unreal Engine

> An Unreal Engine plugin that converts text into speech using the Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API, returning results as playable sound waves and exportable editor assets.

Documentation: https://pandoa.github.io/GoogleTextToSpeech/
Plugin download: https://www.fab.com/listings/1ed738da-6aac-46c2-bbee-d2b42c68c3a9

## Documentation

- [Setup The Plugin](https://pandoa.github.io/GoogleTextToSpeech/setup): Enable the Cloud Text-to-Speech API, create and restrict an API key, and configure it via environment variable, project settings, or `SetAPIKey`. Includes optional C++ module setup.
- [Synthesize Text](https://pandoa.github.io/GoogleTextToSpeech/synth): List available voices with `ListVoices`, synthesize speech to a sound wave, and play or cache the result.
- [Editor Tools](https://pandoa.github.io/GoogleTextToSpeech/editor): Use the in-editor Voice Synthesizer panel to generate speech assets without leaving Unreal.
- [Troubleshooting](https://pandoa.github.io/GoogleTextToSpeech/troubleshoting): Diagnosing common setup and synthesis errors.
- [Support](https://pandoa.github.io/GoogleTextToSpeech/support): Read the Output Log for errors and contact the developer with logs attached.
